title: finding(types): `BaseFieldMetadata.indexed` is now a declared key with zero readers and zero writers, after #4675 retired the designers' Indexed control
body:
Observation-class finding, tripped over while measuring #4676. Filed unassigned; not fixed in any PR.

## What is there

`packages/types/src/field-types.ts` still declares, on `BaseFieldMetadata` — the type `FieldWidgetComponentProps.field` resolves to:

```ts
  /**
   * Field index for database optimization
   */
  indexed?: boolean;
```

## Measured on `origin/main` @ `9ce096fb0` (after PR #4675 merged)

Swept `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src`, excluding `.test.` and `__tests__`:

```
$ grep -rn "\.indexed\b\|indexed:" packages/*/src apps/*/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx \
    | grep -v "\.test\." | grep -v "__tests__"
packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx:440:   * Depth is 0-indexed: roots are 0, their children 1, etc. Every node whose
```

The single hit is the word "0-indexed" inside a prose comment about tree depth. So after #4675:

- **no reader** — nothing in any package or app reads `field.indexed`;
- **no writer** — no object literal sets `indexed:` (the designer write paths that used to were removed by #4675);
- and the key is one `FieldSchema` rejects **by name** (probed against the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0-rc.6: `unrecognized_keys`, with the prescription "never a FieldSchema key; a field-level index flag built no index (#2377). Declare the index in the object's `indexes[]`").

`DesignerFieldDefinition.indexed` was correctly deleted by #4675. This is the *other* declaration, on the renderer-side field-metadata type, and it was outside that PR's surface.

## Why it is worth recording

A declared key that the contract refuses and nobody produces or consumes is the "declared but not delivered" shape this repo treats as first-class: it type-checks, reads as a supported field-metadata property, and would silently do nothing if an AI-written app or widget authored it. The object-level `indexes: [{ name, fields, unique }]` array is the real surface.

Not graded here — severity and whether it is worth a PR are for triage. No `pm:queue`.

Backlinks: #4644 and PR #4675 (the retirement that left it behind), #4676 (the card being measured when this surfaced), objectstack#2377, objectstack#4001.
